description.value: A private resort on 200 feet of sandy beach between Courtenay and Campbell River, offering calm east-coast swimming, full-hookup RV sites, flush showers, and laundry; open year-round but July–August requires minimum weekly bookings.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active beachfront campground and RV resort on a primary Vancouver Island cycling corridor with confirmed showers, laundry, WiFi, and year-round operations — a clear benefit to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: WiFi is explicitly included at no extra charge throughout the resort per the rates page. Pets are welcome in the RV park.
